Package qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.hierarchy

Class HierarchyItem

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.control.TreeItem<RepositoryEntity>
qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.hierarchy.HierarchyItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class HierarchyItem extends javafx.scene.control.TreeItem<RepositoryEntity> implements AutoCloseable
Item of the hierarchy of a TreeView containing RepositoryEntity elements .

Items can be filtered by Experimenter, ExperimenterGroup, and image name.

This item must be closed once no longer used.

Warning: changing the value of this object with TreeItem.setValue(Object) is not supported: such change won't probably be reflected in the UI.

    • HierarchyItem

      public HierarchyItem(RepositoryEntity repositoryEntity, javafx.beans.value.ObservableValue<? extends Experimenter> ownerBinding, javafx.beans.value.ObservableValue<? extends ExperimenterGroup> groupBinding, javafx.beans.value.ObservableValue<Predicate<RepositoryEntity>> labelPredicate)
      Creates a hierarchy item.
      Parameters:
      repositoryEntity - the OMERO entity that will be displayed by this item
      ownerBinding - the children of this item won't be shown if they are not owned by this experimenter
      groupBinding - the children of this item won't be shown if they are not owned by this group
      labelPredicate - the children of this item won't be shown if they are images and don't match this predicate (which is based on the label of this item)
